name: Member progress
summary: Approved member submissions (consent on file). Shows habits, streak and how they feel — not only the body. No weight-loss promises.
slide_pattern: before-after (day 1 vs day 50 photos) → quote (the member's words) → statement (the streak) → cta
extra_voice_rules: The member's own words whenever possible. The generator should use the submission as the source of truth.
Show habits, streak, and how they feel — not only the body. A great member post mentions at least one habit and at least one feeling.
No weight-loss promises. No 'lose X kg in Y days'.
The member's chosen credit (full name, first name, or anonymous) is the only credit used.
extra_checks: Consent on file for the submission. Withdrawal flag is not set.
Every number, date, and habit mentioned in the post exists in the submission.
No before-and-after weight figures outside the consent scope.
